cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's Audit Machine hunt for bills missing from HANGS Construction's books.
First it reads every payment made after the year end.
About $206,000 of June costs are missing from the books.
Next it reads the unpaid bills.
An unpaid legal bill for May and June is missing too.
Four June bills missed the year.
An accrual records a cost in the month it belongs to.
Now it adds up what it found and sets it against materiality.
Then it writes the workpapers and a draft findings memo for the CPA.

All done. The missing bills add up to almost $248,000, just under the auditors' working limit, so the CPA weighs them with the rest of the audit. Eight items stay open. The CPA, a person, concludes and signs. The machine gives no opinion.
